# Frozen-design results (generated by evaluation/final_summary.py)

Rates are shares with a 95% interval from a bootstrap that resamples whole source series. Operating point: thresholds frozen from the development sets so that stable, ambient-free development entities false-alert at <=5%. FPR = alerts on entities whose own data never moves by 1 hour-scale unit. Stealth/fast/local = injected attacks (1/2/3 sigma over a long ramp; 4 sigma over 10 days; 4 sigma in business hours only).
